subject: Re: Kickoff: MULLER learned resizer — A/B results + sweep status
body:
Hi both,

Results from the April A/B, and Deshawn's caution was exactly right: pure drop-in on the frozen tower moved retrieval precision@10 by +0.05, statistically indistinguishable from zero. With a light fine-tune (2 epochs, resizer in the loop), tower 1 gains +0.42 precision@10 and +0.31 recall@50 on the offline eval — consistent with the paper's claim that the multilayer Laplacian filtering sharpens detail the model learns to exploit. Latency delta in Oyin's serving parity check: under 0.3 ms per image, effectively free as promised.

The May sweep across all three towers is running on the B-77-funded allocation; towers 2 and 3 finish this week. One trade-off to flag for the Jun 1 recommendation: the fine-tune requirement means MULLER rides along with each tower's regular retraining cadence rather than shipping instantly — tower 3 doesn't retrain until July, so full rollout completes next quarter regardless of our decision.

Yara
